description.en: North Dakota is a landlocked U.S. state in the Upper Midwest, named after the indigenous Dakota and Sioux peoples. It is bordered by the Canadian provinces of Saskatchewan and Manitoba to the north and by the U.S. states of Minnesota to the east, South Dakota to the south, and Montana to the west.
description.zh-CN: 北达科他州，簡稱北達州，是美國中西部的一州。它是大草原裡最北的一州，包含達科他地區的北半部。
description.zh-TW: 北達科他州，簡稱北達州，是美國中西部的一州。它是大草原裡最北的一州，包含達科他地區的北半部。
